registered_addition_groups.owner: M3-C-N pure bounded private-device goal dual-read window preflight
registered_addition_groups.rationale: The registered sites are deterministic SHA-256 identity derivation, immutable policy/path duplicate checks, and local one-pass set/dictionary accumulation used to validate a supplied digest-only record chain. The module has no filesystem, SQLite, network, operator command, checked-in authorization, default runtime injection, raw text retention, prior private database access, event append, action, scheduler, speech, legacy authority transfer, migration authorization, or M3-E capability.

All registered sites are test-local synthetic digest creation, list/set collection, AST inspection, and deliberate immutable mapping mutations used to prove fail-closed constructor behavior. They do not execute a private-device window, access any existing M3-C-J path or evidence, inject the production tap, retain raw private material, append events, transfer goal authority, authorize migration, or open action, scheduler, speech, or M3-E capabilities.
